dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, terminating at the edge of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth and continuous lateral margins with no significant structural bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline with uniform reflectance across the majority of the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast dark aperture at the anterior dorsal position corresponding to the blowhole; no other point-contrast marks are visible.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of faint, low-contrast longitudinal epidermal creases or folds along the mid-dorsal plane.
